name: Mordecai
summary: Mordecai was a Jew of the tribe of Benjamin in Shushan who raised his cousin Esther as his own daughter. He would not bow to Haman, urged Esther to plead for her people, and rose to be next to the king.

key_moments.title: Saving the King's Life
key_moments.description: As Mordecai sat at the king's gate, he learned that two of the king's doorkeepers planned to kill King Ahasuerus. He told Esther, she told the king in Mordecai's name, and the matter was recorded in the king's chronicles.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Bow to Haman
key_moments.description: The king's servants bowed to Haman as the king had commanded, but Mordecai would not. He had told them he was Jewish, and Haman, full of anger, set out to destroy all of Mordecai's people.

key_moments.title: Tells Esther Not to Keep Silent
key_moments.description: Mordecai warned Esther that she would be no safer in the palace than the other Jews. He asked who knew whether she had become queen for this very time.

key_moments.title: Honored Through the City
key_moments.description: The king told Haman to dress Mordecai in royal clothes and lead him on the king's horse. So Haman brought him through the city, crying out that this was how the king honored a man.

key_moments.title: Given the King's Ring
key_moments.description: After Haman was hanged, the king gave Mordecai the ring taken back from Haman. Esther put Mordecai in charge of Haman's house.
